QuestInfo.name: I Need to Prove Myself to My Daughter
QuestInfo.0: Uh-oh. Bruce seems to be having a family crisis like he did five years ago. Go to Henesys and lend him a sympathetic ear.
QuestInfo.1: Bruce says that he needs to prove himself to his daughter, Ayan, but can't really do it himself. He needs you to bag stomping out #bIron Hogs#k and fetching #b50 Metal Hooves#k for him.
QuestInfo.2: Bruce seems to be having a family crisis like he did five years ago.

0.0:
Oh! *sniffle* It's you. *sniffle* It's been a while since you've seen me so distraught, hasn't it? \n\n
(Bruce wipes his eyes furiously with the sleeve of his jacket.)
0.1: Five years, I think? Oh, please excuse my red eyes and runny nose. It's just that I'm, well, miserable. Maybe you could help?

yes.0: Thank you, thank you, thank you! You have no idea what this means to me. Remember how you found my long-lost daughter Ayan a while back? Well, she still doubts that I'm really her father! It's because I'm not all buff and tough like she is.
yes.1: Long story short, we got into a bit of a tiff and I said I'd prove that I'm her father by killing some monsters. But you know me. Slaying monsters is not my forte.
yes.2: But it's yours, right? I promised her I'd take out Iron Hogs and fetching #b50 Metal Hooves.#k No big deal to someone of your caliber, right? You probably won't even break a sweat.

no.0: *gasp* What? You won't help me...? Oh. T-t-that's okay. I'm sure you're busy. *sniffle* Can you leave? I don't want you to see *sniffle, sniffle, sob* a grown man cry.
